title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
firstLine: You will rejoice to hear that no disaster has accompanied the commencement of an enterprise which you have regarded with such evil forebodings.
begins: The book opens with letters from Robert Walton, an English explorer writing from St. Petersburgh to his sister Mrs. Saville, as he sets out on a voyage toward the North Pole. In later letters his ship meets Victor Frankenstein on the ice; Chapter 1 begins Victor's own story.
happens: Walton hears Victor Frankenstein's story. A Genevese student at Ingolstadt, Victor makes a living creature from dead matter, is horrified, and flees. The abandoned creature teaches himself language by watching the De Lacey family, is driven away by them, and turns vengeful. He kills Victor's young brother William; the servant Justine is condemned for it. He demands a female companion; Victor begins, then destroys her. The creature kills Henry Clerval and, on the wedding night, Elizabeth; Victor's father dies of grief. Victor pursues the creature north and dies aboard Walton's ship. The creature mourns over the body, vows to burn himself on a funeral pile, and is lost on the ice.
